Prepared for generic Cadence Genus synthesis.

Top module: ddr4_controller_top

This prep flow is intentionally generic:
  - copies RTL recursively
  - strips SVA/property/sequence constructs
  - strips debug system tasks like $display/$strobe/$monitor
  - preserves packages, interfaces, and module hierarchy
  - excludes obvious unit-test / testbench files when detected

Included synthesizable source files: 11

Top candidates:
  - ddr4_controller_top (score 183)
  - ddr4_bank_top (score 55)
  - ddr4_refresh_refresh_controller (score 24)
  - ddr4_bank_bank_sequencer (score 16)
  - ddr4_scheduler_scheduler (score 13)
  - ddr4_request_queue (score 9)
  - ddr4_tFAW_tFAW_tracker (score 6)
  - ddr4_bank_activate_fsm (score 5)

Detected clock ports:
  - clk: 5.000 ns
Detected reset ports:
  - rst_n

Preprocessor macros detected in source:
  - none

Notes:
  - If the inferred top is wrong, rerun with --top <module_name>.
  - If the design depends on `ifdef features, rerun with --define NAME.
  - The generated mc_genus.sdc is only a starting point.
  - Interface-heavy designs may still need project-specific constraint or wrapper work.

Typical next step:
  python3 run_genus_netlist.py --builddir build_prep_mc --top ddr4_controller_top

Clarification:
  - This bundle detected no required preprocessor macros (see list above).
  - run_genus_mc.tcl supports optional, opt-in defines via environment variable:
      GENUS_DEFINES="NAME NAME2=1"  (space-separated)
    These are only applied if explicitly set by the user.
key_files.constraints/mc_genus.sdc:
# Auto-generated generic block-level SDC for Genus bring-up
# Review and refine this file before signoff timing work.

create_clock -name clk -period 5.000 [get_ports clk]
set_clock_uncertainty 0.10 [get_clocks clk]

set_false_path -from [get_ports rst_n]

set bidir_ports {}
set reset_ports [get_ports -quiet {rst_n}]
set clock_ports [get_ports -quiet {clk}]
set excluded_inputs  [add_to_collection $clock_ports $reset_ports]
set excluded_outputs $bidir_ports
set timed_inputs  [remove_from_collection [all_inputs]  $excluded_inputs]
set timed_outputs [remove_from_collection [all_outputs] $excluded_outputs]

if {[sizeof_collection $timed_inputs] > 0} { set_input_delay 0.0 -clock clk $timed_inputs }
if {[sizeof_collection $timed_outputs] > 0} { set_output_delay 0.0 -clock clk $timed_outputs }

# Note:
# - inout ports are excluded from generic IO timing here
# - interface/PHY-specific timing should be modeled explicitly later
key_files.run_genus_mc.tcl:
# Auto-generated generic Genus Tcl
if {![info exists ::env(GENUS_LIBS)] || [string trim $::env(GENUS_LIBS)] eq ""} {
    puts "ERROR: Set GENUS_LIBS to one or more SKY130A .lib files before running Genus."
    exit 2
}

set TOP "ddr4_controller_top"
set FILELIST [file normalize "./filelist_genus.f"]
set SDC [file normalize "./constraints/mc_genus.sdc"]
set OUTDIR [file normalize "./../build_genus_mc"]

file mkdir $OUTDIR
file mkdir $OUTDIR/reports
file mkdir $OUTDIR/results

set lib_list [split $::env(GENUS_LIBS)]
set PREPDIR [file dirname $FILELIST]
set_db init_hdl_search_path [list $PREPDIR [file join $PREPDIR rtl]]
set_db init_lib_search_path [list [file dirname [lindex $lib_list 0]]]
set_db library $lib_list
set_db hdl_language sv
set_db information_level 7
set_db hdl_append_generic_ports 0
set_db hdl_resolve_parameterized_instance_with_structural_module true
catch {set_db hdl_track_filename_row_col true}

set ACTIVE_DEFINES [list none]
if {[info exists ::env(GENUS_DEFINES)] && [string trim $::env(GENUS_DEFINES)] ne ""} {
    set ACTIVE_DEFINES [split $::env(GENUS_DEFINES)]
}
if {[llength $ACTIVE_DEFINES] > 0} {
    set_db hdl_define $ACTIVE_DEFINES
}
puts "DEFINES  = $ACTIVE_DEFINES"

puts "TOP      = $TOP"
puts "FILELIST = $FILELIST"
puts "SDC      = $SDC"
puts "OUTDIR   = $OUTDIR"
puts "LIBS     = $lib_list"

# Optional, opt-in preprocessor defines (space-separated), e.g.:
#   export GENUS_DEFINES="FOO BAR=1"
# Note: prep may report detected macros in README_prepared.txt; this script does not
# auto-enable them to avoid silently changing behavior.
set GENUS_DEFINES_LIST {}
if {[info exists ::env(GENUS_DEFINES)] && [string trim $::env(GENUS_DEFINES)] ne ""} {
    set GENUS_DEFINES_LIST [split [string trim $::env(GENUS_DEFINES)] " "]
    puts "GENUS_DEFINES = $GENUS_DEFINES_LIST"
}

if {[llength $GENUS_DEFINES_LIST] > 0} {
    read_hdl -sv -define $GENUS_DEFINES_LIST -f $FILELIST
} else {
    read_hdl -sv -f $FILELIST
}
elaborate $TOP
check_design -unresolved > $OUTDIR/reports/check_unresolved_pre_sdc.rpt

if {[file exists $SDC]} {
    read_sdc $SDC
} else {
    puts "WARNING: SDC file not found; continuing without constraints"
}

set_db syn_generic_effort medium
set_db syn_map_effort medium
set_db syn_opt_effort medium

syn_generic
syn_map
syn_opt

report_qor > $OUTDIR/reports/qor.rpt
report_area > $OUTDIR/reports/area.rpt
report_timing -max_paths 20 > $OUTDIR/reports/timing.rpt
report_power > $OUTDIR/reports/power.rpt
report_gates > $OUTDIR/reports/gates.rpt
check_design > $OUTDIR/reports/check_design_post_syn.rpt
report_messages > $OUTDIR/reports/messages.rpt

write_hdl > $OUTDIR/results/${TOP}_mapped.v
write_sdc > $OUTDIR/results/${TOP}_mapped.sdc
write_design -innovus -base_name $OUTDIR/results/${TOP}

puts "Genus run complete."
exit
